title: 1940s Fashionable Group Portrait, Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A well-composed 1940s black-and-white snapshot featuring three sharply dressed individuals standing outside a brick building. The man on the left wears a wide-lapel light suit and tie, holding a pipe. The young woman in the center wears a striped tailored jacket, dark skirt, halo hat, and carries a textured leather clutch. The woman on the right wears a belted trench coat dress adorned with a floral-embellished wide hat and ankle-strap heels. The tailored shoulder pads and hat styles are classic mid-1940s fashion hallmarks.
